toast.preparationFailed.en: Could not read the Session for copying. Try again.
toast.preparationFailed.zh: 无法读取 Session 进行复制，请重试

toast.clipboardFailed.en: Could not write to the clipboard. Check clipboard permission and try again.
toast.clipboardFailed.zh: 无法写入剪贴板，请检查剪贴板权限后重试

dialog.sessionMode.hint.view.en: Read only: viewers read files and the session record within the share's scope and can message the session, but every tool runs in a read-only sandbox and no file can be written.
dialog.sessionMode.hint.view.zh: 仅可查看：观看者可以读取分享范围内的文件与会话记录，也能向这个会话发消息；所有工具都在只读沙箱中运行，不能写文件。

dialog.sessionMode.hint.write.en: Workspace write: the viewer works in a bounded writable sandbox — it modifies files inside the share’s scope under the writable ceiling; reads and writes beyond that scope are refused, and your global settings, credentials, and other Sessions stay closed.
dialog.sessionMode.hint.write.zh: 工作区内修改：观看者在可写沙箱里工作——可以在分享范围内修改文件，写入受可写上限约束；分享范围之外的读写都会被拒绝，你的全局设置、凭据与其它会话仍不开放。

dialog.allowsFork.en: Allow viewers to fork the session

dialog.allowsForkHint.en: Forked sessions keep the same permissions as the source session.
dialog.allowsForkHint.zh: 观看者分叉出的会话与源会话权限相同。

dialog.sessionMode.notGranted.en: This Harness did not report the session permission back: an older owner build needs an upgrade before the share can carry it.
dialog.sessionMode.notGranted.zh: 此 Harness 未回读会话权限：所有者端版本过旧时请先升级，再重新创建分享。

dialog.permissions.saved.en: Share permissions and plugin endpoints saved.
dialog.permissions.saved.zh: 已保存分享权限与插件端点。

dialog.permissions.failed.en: The share permissions were not saved. Try again.
dialog.permissions.failed.zh: 分享权限未保存，请重试。

dialog.permissions.partial.en: The session permission was updated, but the plugin endpoints were not saved. Try again.
dialog.permissions.partial.zh: 会话权限已更新，但插件端点未保存，请重试。

dialog.permissions.modeUnsupported.en: This Harness did not report a session permission, so it cannot be changed here.
dialog.permissions.modeUnsupported.zh: 此 Harness 未回读会话权限，不能在这里修改。

dialog.permissions.discard.en: Unsaved changes; choosing Done again discards them.
dialog.permissions.discard.zh: 有未保存的改动；再次点击「完成」将丢弃它们。

dialog.capabilities.description.en: Choose one tier for this share; the tier expands at save time into the endpoints the plugins declare now, so endpoints they add later stay closed.
dialog.capabilities.description.zh: 对这个分享统一选一个档位；档位在保存时展开成插件当前声明的全部端点，之后新增的端点不会自动开放。

dialog.capabilities.count.zh: 已向观看者开放 {count} 个端点

dialog.capabilities.summary.write.zh: 可写 · {readable} 只读 + {writable} 可写

dialog.capabilities.stale.en: The saved selection is not one whole tier; saving again replaces it with the tier you pick.
dialog.capabilities.stale.zh: 当前记录不是整档选择；重新保存会按所选档位覆盖。

dialog.capabilities.noReadable.en: No plugin offers a read-only endpoint, so Read-only cannot be chosen.
dialog.capabilities.noReadable.zh: 没有插件提供只读端点，因此不能选择「可读」。

dialog.capabilities.noWritable.en: No plugin offers a writable endpoint, so Writable cannot be chosen.
dialog.capabilities.noWritable.zh: 没有插件提供可写端点，因此不能选择「可写」。

dialog.capabilities.writeHint.en: A writable endpoint takes effect only when the shared Session allows writing, and is destructive inside a writable share.
dialog.capabilities.writeHint.zh: 可写端点在被分享会话允许写入时才生效，且在可写分享中具有破坏性。

dialog.capabilities.empty.en: No plugin currently declares endpoints to share.
dialog.capabilities.empty.zh: 当前没有插件声明可分享端点。

dialog.capabilities.createFailed.en: The share was created, but its plugin endpoints were not saved; retry in Share permissions.
dialog.capabilities.createFailed.zh: 分享已创建，但插件端点未保存；请到分享权限中重试。

dialog.linkHelp.en: Closing this panel does not stop the share.
dialog.linkHelp.zh: 关闭此面板不会停止分享。

dialog.copyFailed.en: Could not copy the link. Select the share link and copy it manually.
dialog.copyFailed.zh: 未能复制链接。请选中分享链接后手动复制。

dialog.accessUnavailable.en: Access details for this share are unavailable. Existing permissions are unchanged.
dialog.accessUnavailable.zh: 此分享的访问范围详情暂不可用，已有权限不变。

dialog.selectedCount.zh: 分享服务已确认 {count} 位所选人员。

dialog.deploymentAccess.en: Deployment-authorized identities: {count}. Selection is not the only access rule.
dialog.deploymentAccess.zh: 部署还配置了 {count} 个可访问身份；访问范围不只由此处选择决定。

dialog.selectedRetired.en: This share keeps its older "specific colleagues" scope; new shares offer only the two modes above.
dialog.selectedRetired.zh: 这是旧版“指定同事可看”的分享：范围保持不变，新建分享只能选择上面两种方式。

dialog.description.en: Create a read-only Liveshare link for {title}
dialog.description.zh: 创建一个只读 Liveshare 链接：{title}

dialog.relaySaved.en: Saved. New shares use this address.
dialog.relaySaved.zh: 已保存，新的分享将使用该地址。

dialog.relayInvalid.en: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
dialog.relayInvalid.zh: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的完整地址。

dialog.relayReverify.en: The address changed; sign in again on the new address.
dialog.relayReverify.zh: 地址已更换，请在新地址重新登录。

dialog.relayUnsavedHint.en: This address is not saved yet; save it to put it in force.
dialog.relayUnsavedHint.zh: 这个地址尚未保存；保存后才会生效。

dialog.identity.expired.en: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again before creating a share.
dialog.identity.expired.zh: 登录已过期，请重新登录后再创建分享。

dialog.identity.unverified.en: You are not signed in, so you cannot create a share.
dialog.identity.unverified.zh: 尚未登录，无法创建分享。

dialog.identity.relayChanged.en: The current sign-in belongs to another Relay address. Sign in again on this address.
dialog.identity.relayChanged.zh: 当前登录属于另一个 Relay 地址，请在本地址重新登录。

dialog.identity.unknown.en: Sign-in status is unavailable right now. Try again later; no share is created before you sign in.
dialog.identity.unknown.zh: 登录状态暂时不可用，请稍后重试；登录前不会创建分享。

dialog.identity.verifyBlocked.en: Save the address and confirm it answers before signing in.
dialog.identity.verifyBlocked.zh: 请先保存地址并确认可连接，再登录。

dialog.identity.loginWaiting.en: Finish signing in in the window that opened.
dialog.identity.loginWaiting.zh: 请在打开的窗口中完成登录。

dialog.identity.loginDone.en: Signed in; reading the account state.
dialog.identity.loginDone.zh: 登录已完成，正在读取状态。

dialog.identity.loginCancelled.en: Sign-in cancelled; no credential was saved.
dialog.identity.loginCancelled.zh: 已取消登录，未保存任何凭据。

dialog.identity.loginExpired.zh: 这次登录已过期，请重新发起。

dialog.identity.loginMismatch.en: The sign-in answer did not belong to this request and was ignored.
dialog.identity.loginMismatch.zh: 登录回答不属于本次请求，已忽略。

dialog.identity.loginReplayed.en: This sign-in was already used; start again.
dialog.identity.loginReplayed.zh: 这次登录已被使用过，请重新发起。

dialog.identity.loginUnavailable.en: Cannot start sign-in: the Relay is unavailable or this address does not support it.
dialog.identity.loginUnavailable.zh: 无法发起登录：Relay 不可用或该地址尚不支持。

dialog.identity.loginBlocked.en: Cannot open the sign-in window (the browser may have blocked it). Allow pop-ups and try again.
dialog.identity.loginBlocked.zh: 无法打开登录窗口（可能被浏览器拦截）。请允许弹窗后重试。

dialog.identity.loginFailed.en: Sign-in did not finish. Try again.

dialog.identity.renewed.en: Renewed automatically within the granted authorization.
dialog.identity.renewed.zh: 已在有效授权内自动续期。

dialog.identity.relayUnsupported.en: The Relay at this address does not verify identities yet. Upgrade it before creating a share; this page will not create an anonymous one.
dialog.identity.relayUnsupported.zh: 当前 Relay 地址还不支持身份认证，请先升级 Relay 后再创建分享；不会创建匿名分享。

dialog.help.en: Shares this Session only; the session permission decides what the viewer may do, and you can stop it any time in Manage shares.
dialog.help.zh: 只分享这个会话；对方能做什么由“会话权限”决定，随时可以在“管理分享”里停止。

dialog.mode.open.en: Anyone in the organization with the link
dialog.mode.open.zh: 组织内任何持链接的人可查看

dialog.hostUnavailable.en: Cannot reach the DSH Liveshare share service.
dialog.hostUnavailable.zh: 无法连接 DSH Liveshare 分享服务。

dialog.testWarn.en: Relay HTTP is reachable but registration did not finish and the Host reported no reason. You can still create the share; the gateway retries.
dialog.testWarn.zh: Relay HTTP 可访问，但注册未完成（服务端未给出原因）；仍可创建，网关会自动重试。

dialog.testFail.en: Relay connection failed (the Host reported no reason).
dialog.testFail.zh: Relay 连接失败（服务端未给出原因）。

dialog.addressHint.en: Save the share service address first.
dialog.addressHint.zh: 请先保存分享服务地址。

dialog.connectivityChecking.en: Testing whether the share service address answers…
dialog.connectivityChecking.zh: 正在测试分享服务地址连通性…

dialog.permissionChecking.en: Checking whether this host may publish at this address…
dialog.permissionChecking.zh: 正在校验本机能否在该地址发布分享…

dialog.permissionOk.en: Signed in; this host can publish shares.
dialog.permissionOk.zh: 已登录，本机可以发布分享。

dialog.permissionPending.en: This address must be checked before a share can be created.
dialog.permissionPending.zh: 需要先校验权限，才能创建分享。

dialog.permissionFailed.en: The permission check did not finish (the Host reported no reason).
dialog.permissionFailed.zh: 权限校验未完成（Host 未给出原因）。

dialog.noOutgoing.zh: 还没有分享出去的会话

dialog.stopFailed.en: Failed to stop sharing. Try again.
dialog.stopFailed.zh: 停止分享失败，请稍后重试。

manage.description.en: View the online state and access scope of every share.
manage.description.zh: 查看每个分享的在线状态与访问范围。

manage.stop.description.en: The published link stops working immediately, and anyone viewing it loses access.
manage.stop.description.zh: 已发布的链接会立即失效，正在查看的人将无法继续访问。

manage.stop.acknowledge.en: I understand the published link stops working immediately
manage.stop.acknowledge.zh: 我明白已发布的链接会立即失效

manage.identityExpired.en: This sign-in has expired, which blocks creating new shares only. The shares published below are unaffected: their links still copy and stay manageable.
manage.identityExpired.zh: 登录凭据已过期：只影响新建分享。下列已发布分享不受影响，链接仍可复制、仍可管理。

manage.empty.zh: 还没有分享出去的会话。

manage.unavailable.en: Could not load shares. Showing the last known state.
manage.unavailable.zh: 无法获取分享列表，显示的是最后一次已知状态。

manage.historyFailed.en: Could not load history. Try again.
manage.historyFailed.zh: 历史记录读取失败，请重试。

manage.allowsForkSwitch.zh: 设置「{title}」是否允许观看者分叉会话

manage.sessionModeUnsupported.en: This Harness did not report a session permission, so it cannot be set here.
manage.sessionModeUnsupported.zh: 此 Harness 未回读会话权限，无法在这里设置。

manage.sessionModeFailed.en: The session permission was not saved. Try again.
manage.sessionModeFailed.zh: 会话权限未保存，请重试。

viewer.readonlyNote.en: Read only: you can drive this Session, but you read files inside the share’s scope only and modify nothing.
viewer.readonlyNote.zh: 仅可查看：可以驱动这个会话，但只能在分享范围内读取文件，不能修改内容。

viewer.writeUnavailableNote.en: The owner granted writing, but this session cannot be driven right now; sending becomes available once it is prepared.
viewer.writeUnavailableNote.zh: 分享者已授予写入，但这个会话当前无法被驱动；就绪后即可发送消息。

viewer.model.title.en: The model this Session runs on, chosen by the owner who shared it
viewer.model.title.zh: 这个会话正在使用的模型，由分享者决定

viewer.permission.title.en: The session permission this share carries, set by the owner
viewer.permission.title.zh: 这份分享的会话权限，由分享者决定

viewer.empty.en: This session has no content to show yet.
viewer.empty.zh: 这个会话还没有可显示的内容。

viewer.offline.en: The share is offline. It reconnects automatically.
viewer.offline.zh: 分享暂时离线，稍后会自动重连。

viewer.expired.en: This share expired and no longer grants access. Ask the owner to share again.
viewer.expired.zh: 该分享已过期，不再提供访问。请联系分享者重新分享。

viewer.revoked.en: The owner stopped sharing or revoked your access.
viewer.revoked.zh: 分享者已停止或撤销你的访问。

viewer.reauthenticate.en: Your sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
viewer.reauthenticate.zh: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录。

viewer.status.invalid.en: This link is not valid, or that share was deleted.
viewer.status.invalid.zh: 链接无效，或这条分享已被删除。

viewer.status.invalidHint.en: Check that the link is complete, or ask the owner for a new one.
viewer.status.invalidHint.zh: 请检查链接是否完整；也可以找分享者要一条新链接。

viewer.status.offline.en: The owner is offline right now; this page reconnects automatically.
viewer.status.offline.zh: 分享者当前不在线，会自动重连。

viewer.status.offlineHint.en: Wait a moment or choose Retry; if it stays offline, contact the owner.
viewer.status.offlineHint.zh: 稍等片刻或点「重试」；长时间仍然离线请联系分享者。

viewer.status.stopped.zh: 分享者已停止这条分享。

viewer.status.stoppedHint.en: Ask the owner to turn it back on if you still need access.
viewer.status.stoppedHint.zh: 如需继续访问，请联系分享者重新开启。

viewer.status.expiredHint.en: Ask the owner to share the session again.
viewer.status.expiredHint.zh: 请联系分享者重新分享。

viewer.status.unavailable.en: The share service is unavailable right now; retrying.
viewer.status.unavailable.zh: 服务暂时不可用，正在重试。

viewer.status.unavailableHint.en: Try again shortly; if it stays unavailable, come back later.
viewer.status.unavailableHint.zh: 请稍后重试；持续不可用请联系分享者或稍后再来。

viewer.picker.historicalNote.en: These shares predate verified identities; their access is unchanged.
viewer.picker.historicalNote.zh: 这些分享创建于身份验证之前，访问范围保持不变。

viewer.relaySilent.en: liveshare: the Relay answered nothing for {subject}
viewer.relaySilent.zh: liveshare：中继未对 {subject} 返回内容

viewer.unreachable.en: liveshare: {subject} did not reach the Relay, retrying
viewer.unreachable.zh: liveshare：{subject} 未能送达中继，正在重试

viewer.sharePath.unavailable.en: This page cannot open workspace files: a share hands over file paths, not file contents.
viewer.sharePath.unavailable.zh: 此页面无法打开工作区文件：分享提供的是文件路径，不是文件内容。

viewer.reason.fork-not-permitted.en: The owner does not allow branching this Session
viewer.reason.fork-not-permitted.zh: 分享者未允许分支此会话

viewer.reason.fork-not-implemented.en: This deployment does not support branching yet

viewer.reason.write-not-implemented.en: This deployment does not support writing yet

viewer.reason.source-session-mismatch.en: The branch named a different Session than the share carries
viewer.reason.source-session-mismatch.zh: 分支请求指向的会话不是该分享的会话

viewer.reason.fork-operation-conflict.en: This branch request named a different prefix than the earlier one, so no new Session was created
viewer.reason.fork-operation-conflict.zh: 这次分支请求指定的前缀与之前那次不同，未再新建会话

viewer.reason.fork-enforcement-failed.en: The branch Session was created, but its sandbox limits could not be installed, so it cannot be used
viewer.reason.fork-enforcement-failed.zh: 分支会话已创建，但沙箱限制安装失败，无法使用

viewer.reason.mode-view.en: The owner set this share to read only
viewer.reason.mode-view.zh: 分享者已把此分享改为仅可查看

viewer.reason.unconfirmed.en: This share’s current state could not be confirmed; it stays read-only until it is
viewer.reason.unconfirmed.zh: 无法确认该分享的当前状态，确认前保持只读

viewer.reason.fork-viewer-unknown.en: The Relay did not confirm your identity, so the branch cannot be created
viewer.reason.fork-viewer-unknown.zh: 中继未确认你的身份，无法完成分支

viewer.reason.fork-unknown-child.en: This Session is not a branch of a share
viewer.reason.fork-unknown-child.zh: 此会话不是分享产生的分支

viewer.reason.fork-viewer-mismatch.en: That branch belongs to another viewer
viewer.reason.fork-viewer-mismatch.zh: 该分支属于其他观看者

viewer.reason.fork-source-revoked.en: The share this branch came from is no longer active
viewer.reason.fork-source-revoked.zh: 该分支来源的分享已不可用

viewer.reason.fork-ceiling-uninstalled.en: This Host has not installed the read-only execution limits
viewer.reason.fork-ceiling-uninstalled.zh: 此 Host 尚未安装只读执行上限

viewer.reason.fork-prepare-failed.en: The Host could not prepare this branch, so this action did not run
viewer.reason.fork-prepare-failed.zh: Host 未能准备好此分支，本次操作没有执行

viewer.reason.share-not-writable.en: The owner does not allow writing this Session
viewer.reason.share-not-writable.zh: 分享者已不允许写入此会话

viewer.reason.source-write-unavailable.en: This Host could not confine the shared Session, so it cannot drive it
viewer.reason.source-write-unavailable.zh: 此 Host 未能限制共享会话的执行，因此无法驱动它

viewer.reason.prompt-identity-missing.en: This send carried no request identity to attribute, so the Host did not run it
viewer.reason.prompt-identity-missing.zh: 这次发送没有可供署名的请求标识，Host 没有执行

viewer.reason.viewer-not-authorized.en: Your account no longer has access to this share
viewer.reason.viewer-not-authorized.zh: 你的账号已无权访问该分享

viewer.reason.liveshare/read-only.en: This Session is outside the share you hold, so it was not written
viewer.reason.liveshare/read-only.zh: 这个会话不在你持有的分享范围内，未写入

toggle.zh: 展开或收起 NodeJS 诊断

resize.zh: 调整 NodeJS 诊断面板高度

applicationsTitle.en: Manage applications computer use can access
applicationsTitle.zh: 管理 Computer Use 可访问的应用

setupTitle.en: Set up computer use before use
setupTitle.zh: 使用 Computer Use 前需要设置

setupBody.en: Computer use is enabled. Before using it, switch to PTC mode and grant Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions. Open the plugin details to complete setup.
setupBody.zh: Computer Use 插件已开启。使用前请切换到 PTC 模式，并授予辅助功能和屏幕录制权限。请前往插件详情页完成设置。

setupQueryFailed.en: Computer use is enabled, but system permissions could not be checked. Open the plugin details to see the error and retry.
setupQueryFailed.zh: Computer Use 插件已开启，但暂时无法检测系统权限。请前往插件详情页查看原因并重试。

defaultBody.en: Computer use is available only in PTC mode.
defaultBody.zh: Computer Use 仅在 PTC 模式中可用。

defaultUnavailable.en: Could not read the default mode. Check it in Settings.
defaultUnavailable.zh: 无法读取默认模式，请在设置中检查

defaultNotSaved.en: The default mode was not saved. Try again.
defaultNotSaved.zh: 默认模式未保存，请重试

defaultFailed.en: Could not change the default mode: {message}

persistentBody.en: Keep variables and application objects across tool calls. Switching restarts the PTC runtime.
persistentBody.zh: 跨工具调用保留变量和应用对象。切换会重启 PTC 执行器。

persistentUnavailable.en: Could not read the PTC execution mode. Check it in Settings.
persistentUnavailable.zh: 无法读取 PTC 执行方式，请在设置中检查

persistentReadOnly.zh: PTC 执行方式设置为只读

persistentNotSaved.en: The PTC execution mode was not saved. Try again.
persistentNotSaved.zh: PTC 执行方式未保存，请重试

persistentFailed.en: Could not change the PTC execution mode: {message}
persistentFailed.zh: 无法切换 PTC 执行方式：{message}

accessibilityUse.en: Read interface controls, click, and type.
accessibilityUse.zh: 读取界面控件、点击和输入文字

accessibilityPermission.en: In System Settings, allow {application} to read interface controls, click, and type.
accessibilityPermission.zh: 在系统设置中允许 {application} 读取界面、点击和输入。

screenRecordingPermission.en: In System Settings, allow {application} to capture application windows.
screenRecordingPermission.zh: 在系统设置中允许 {application} 截取应用窗口。

permissionHint.en: Manage Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions in System Settings.
permissionHint.zh: 在系统设置中管理辅助功能和屏幕录制权限

retryAllowed.en: The next application selection will ask again; access has not been granted
retryAllowed.zh: 下次选择此应用时将重新询问，当前尚未授权

noApps.zh: 暂无始终允许或不允许访问的应用。

requested.en: Follow the guide at the bottom of System Settings
requested.zh: 请按系统设置底部的引导完成授权

column.scope.title.en: A turn row holds the turn total; click a row to expand or collapse its steps
column.scope.title.zh: 轮次行是该轮的合计；点一行展开或折叠它的每一步

column.prompt.title.en: What opened this turn: a human prompt shows its text, automation shows a source badge
column.prompt.title.zh: 这一轮是由什么触发的；人写的提示词显示正文，自动触发显示来源标签

column.did.title.en: Tools this step called and how often; a step without tool calls previews its answer text
column.did.title.zh: 该步调用的工具与次数；没有工具调用的步显示回答正文的摘要

column.context.title.en: usage input tokens + cache read + cache write
column.context.title.zh: 该步 usage 的输入词数 + 缓存读 + 缓存写

column.output.title.en: usage output tokens of the step
column.output.title.zh: 该步 usage 的输出词数

column.cache.title.en: cache read ÷ (input + cache read + cache write): the share of the prompt served from cache
column.cache.title.zh: 缓存读 ÷（输入 + 缓存读 + 缓存写）：提示词里命中缓存的比例

cache.detail.zh: 缓存读 {read} · 输入 {input} · 缓存写 {write}

column.ttft.title.en: step start to the first output fragment (TTFT)
column.ttft.title.zh: 步开始到第一个输出片段（TTFT）

column.model.title.en: step start to the settled reply (includes the first-token delay)
column.model.title.zh: 步开始到收到完整回复（含首 token 延迟）

column.tps.title.zh: 输出词数 ÷ 生成秒数（TPS，tok/s）

column.tool.title.en: sum of every tool call up to its result inside the step; calls without a result are excluded
column.tool.title.zh: 该步内每次工具调用到拿到结果的耗时之和；还没有结果的调用不计

column.time.title.en: total split: light blue first token, blue generation, orange tool calls, gray everything else. Bar length uses a square-root scale; steps compare only with steps of the same turn, turns with turns
column.time.title.zh: 总用时拆分：浅蓝 首 token、蓝 生成、橙 工具调用、灰 其余。条长按平方根刻度，步只和同一轮的步比，轮只和轮比

step.toggle.aria.en: Expand or collapse the tool details of step {step}
step.toggle.aria.zh: 展开或折叠第 {step} 步的工具详情

compaction.title.en: Compaction runs are shown separately and excluded from the turn's step totals
compaction.title.zh: 压缩调用单独展示，不并入轮次的步骤合计

context.delta.title.en: Prompt delta against the previous measured step in the turn; negative means the context shrank (for example after compaction)
context.delta.title.zh: 相对同轮上一步的提示词增量；负值表示上下文减少（如压缩）

event.retry.detail.zh: 第 {retry} 次重试 · 等待 {delay}

event.attempt.detail.en: Model attempt without a committed message
event.attempt.detail.zh: 未提交消息的模型尝试

event.title.en: Non-step event rows: request, prompt, tool-set, retry, context-refresh, approval, and prune changes excluded from the turn step totals
event.title.zh: 非步骤事件行：解释请求、提示词、工具集、重试、上下文刷新、审批和裁剪变化，不计入轮次的步骤合计

step.partial.title.en: This step's start and end events are not in the current event window (trimmed while the tab reconnected or the window was rebuilt), so first-token, model time and total have no start to subtract from; reloading the tab reassembles from the full window
step.partial.title.zh: 这一步的开始与结束事件不在当前事件窗口里（页签重连或窗口重建时被截断），首 token、模型用时、总用时都没有起点可以相减；重新加载页签会从完整窗口重新装配

state.cacheMiss.title.en: The prompt barely hit the cache: usually the first request after a restart or a session resume, paid at full input price
state.cacheMiss.title.zh: 这一步的提示词几乎没命中缓存：进程重启、会话恢复后的第一次请求都是这样，输入按全价计

state.aborted.title.en: The step closed without a settled reply (usually cancelled or failed)
state.aborted.title.zh: 该步已经结束，但没有收到完整回复（多为被取消或失败）

partial.en: {count} tool calls have no result yet; this is the lower bound of known time
partial.zh: 还有 {count} 次工具调用没有拿到结果，这里是已知耗时的下限

empty.en: No measurable step in the current window.
empty.zh: 当前窗口里还没有可以测量的步骤。

contextMode.latest.title.en: Turn rows show the last measured step's prompt size (final context); the total row stays cumulative
contextMode.latest.title.zh: 轮次行显示最后一步的提示词大小（最终上下文）；合计行始终为累计值

contextMode.cumulative.title.en: Turn rows show the sum of prompt sizes across the turn's steps (cumulative processing); the total row stays cumulative
contextMode.cumulative.title.zh: 轮次行显示该轮各步提示词大小之和（累计处理量）；合计行始终为累计值

totals.full.title.en: Totals for the complete session; total time is model time + tool time (no inter-turn gaps)
totals.full.title.zh: 整段会话合计；总用时为模型用时 + 工具用时（不含跨轮空隙）

totals.window.title.en: Totals for the turns loaded in this window; the context cell is cumulative across steps
totals.window.title.zh: 当前已加载窗口的合计；上下文为各步累计值

turn.toggle.title.en: Expand or collapse the steps of this turn
turn.toggle.title.zh: 展开或折叠这一轮的每一步

did.total.en: {chars} characters of tool output in this step; they become part of the next prompt
did.total.zh: 本步工具输出合计 {chars} 字符，会进入下一步的上下文

detail.title.en: Click this row to expand or collapse the tool details
detail.title.zh: 点这一行展开或收起工具详情

detail.answer.truncated.en: Answer is long; only the first 16,000 chars are kept
detail.answer.truncated.zh: 回答过长，仅展示前 16,000 字符

detail.emptyBody.zh: 这条调用没有留下正文

detail.hidden.en: {count} more calls are not listed (at most {limit} per step)
detail.hidden.zh: 还有 {count} 次调用没有列出（一步最多列 {limit} 次）

detail.wrap.title.en: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways
detail.wrap.title.zh: 长行换行显示，不出现横向滚动

detail.raw.title.zh: 查看原始 JSON 参数

detail.lineCap.zh: 只显示前 {shown} 行，共 {total} 行

detail.truncated.en: Too long: only the first {chars} characters are kept
detail.truncated.zh: 内容过长，这里只保留了前 {chars} 字符

tool.failed.title.en: {count} tool calls in this step returned an error result
tool.failed.title.zh: 该步有 {count} 次工具调用返回错误结果

bar.running.en: not finished yet: this is elapsed time
bar.running.zh: 还没结束，这是已用时间

imagePreview.hint.en: Hover or focus to preview this turn's images; click to open the full image
imagePreview.hint.zh: 悬停或聚焦预览这一轮的图片，点击查看大图

imagePreview.open.zh: 查看第 {index} 张图（共 {count} 张）

version-error.en: This plugin is incompatible with this DSH version. Update DSH and retry.
version-error.zh: 插件与当前 DSH 版本不兼容，请更新 DSH 后重试。

management-error.en: Could not enable the plugin. Open its details to check the error and retry.
management-error.zh: 无法启用插件，请打开详情检查错误后重试。

scope.en: Available in all conversations when enabled
scope.zh: 启用后可在所有会话中使用

already-enabled.en: Already selected in Plugins. Open details to check its runtime status.
already-enabled.zh: 已在插件页开启，可查看详情了解运行状态

restart-required.zh: 已保存，重启 DSH 后生效

failed.en: Could not enable. Retry or check Plugins.
failed.zh: 启用失败。可重试或在插件页检查。

unconfirmed.en: Could not confirm whether the plugin was enabled. Retry to check.
unconfirmed.zh: 无法确认插件是否已启用，可重试确认。

lookup-failed.en: Could not load this plugin’s details. Try again.
lookup-failed.zh: 无法读取插件信息，请重试。

unavailable.en: This plugin cannot be enabled now. Check Plugins.
unavailable.zh: 这个插件当前无法启用，请在插件页检查。

unknown.en: This recommendation is unavailable. Reopen the conversation.
unknown.zh: 找不到这条推荐，请重新打开会话。

access-denied.en: You do not have permission to change this profile.
access-denied.zh: 没有修改此配置的权限。

not-live-root.en: Use this recommendation in its original conversation.
not-live-root.zh: 请在原会话中操作这条推荐。

closing.en: The service is reloading. Try again shortly.
closing.zh: 服务正在重载，请稍后重试。

transport.en: Could not confirm the result. Refresh and try again.
transport.zh: 无法确认操作结果，请刷新后重试。

diff.showFileTreeLeft.en: Show file tree on the left

diff.moveFileTreeRight.en: Move file tree to the right

guide.description.en: Review code changes and this session’s change requests
guide.description.zh: 查看代码变更与本会话的变更请求

review.inputFailed.en: The input cannot accept a reference yet. Try again shortly.
review.inputFailed.zh: 输入框暂时无法添加引用，请稍后重试

review.saveFailed.en: Could not save the review draft. Check browser storage and try again.
review.saveFailed.zh: 无法保存评审草稿，请检查浏览器存储后重试

review.unknown.en: The submission outcome is unknown. Check GitHub before publishing again.
review.unknown.zh: 无法确认提交结果。请先在 GitHub 核对，避免重复发布

review.summaryRequired.en: Enter a review summary to request changes.
review.summaryRequired.zh: 请求更改时，请填写评审总结

review.stale.en: The PR has new commits. Refresh and select the comment lines again.
review.stale.zh: PR 已有新提交，请刷新并重新选择评论行

review.unsupported.en: This code host does not support review submission.
review.unsupported.zh: 此代码托管服务不支持提交评审

review.loadFailed.en: Could not read review drafts. Check browser storage.
review.loadFailed.zh: 无法读取评审草稿，请检查浏览器存储

header.attention.en: Change requests of this Session need attention
header.attention.zh: 本会话的变更请求需要处理

checkout.none.en: This directory is not a Git repository
checkout.none.zh: 当前目录不是 Git 仓库

checkout.failed.en: Git information could not be read
checkout.failed.zh: 无法读取 Git 信息

changes.empty.en: This Session has no change requests yet
changes.empty.zh: 本会话还没有变更请求

changes.emptyHint.en: Change requests linked to this Session (created, viewed, edited, or checked out, or open on its current or pushed branches) appear here
changes.emptyHint.zh: 本会话关联的变更请求（创建、查看、编辑或检出的，以及所在分支或推送分支上的）会显示在这里

changes.local.viewAria.en: View the changes of this Session: {count} files, {added} lines added, {deleted} lines deleted
changes.local.viewAria.zh: 查看本会话的变更：{count} 个文件，新增 {added} 行，删除 {deleted} 行

changes.local.prompt.en: Create a change request for the changes of this Session
changes.local.prompt.zh: 为本会话的变更创建变更请求

signin.title.en: Sign in to {host} to show change request status
signin.title.zh: 登录 {host} 后才能显示变更请求状态

signin.unavailable.en: Change requests on {host} could not be read: {message}
signin.unavailable.zh: 无法读取 {host} 上的变更请求：{message}

stream.failed.en: The change request panel could not load
stream.failed.zh: 无法加载变更请求面板

change.checks.truncated.zh: 已加载 {count} 项检查，仍有更多

change.failure.unavailable.en: The change request status could not be read
change.failure.unavailable.zh: 无法读取变更请求状态

change.failure.notFound.en: The change request does not exist or is not accessible
change.failure.notFound.zh: 变更请求不存在或没有访问权限

change.failure.unauthenticated.en: Sign in to read its status

change.unserved.en: Change request status is not supported for this code host yet
change.unserved.zh: 暂不支持读取该平台的变更请求状态

change.viewChangesAria.en: View the changes of {name}: {added} lines added, {deleted} lines deleted
change.viewChangesAria.zh: 查看 {name} 的变更：新增 {added} 行，删除 {deleted} 行

change.mergeNote.squash.zh: 把全部提交压缩成一个提交

change.mergeNote.merge.en: Keep every commit and add a merge commit
change.mergeNote.merge.zh: 保留全部提交，并新增一个合并提交

change.mergeChanged.en: New commits arrived. Review them before reopening the merge menu.
change.mergeChanged.zh: 提交已更新，请重新检查后再打开合并菜单

diff.scopeNote.branch.zh: 与 {base} 比较，包含未提交的修改

diff.scopeNote.uncommitted.en: Compared with HEAD, including untracked files
diff.scopeNote.uncommitted.zh: 与 HEAD 比较，包含未跟踪的文件

diff.scopeNote.unstaged.en: Compared with the index, including untracked files
diff.scopeNote.unstaged.zh: 与暂存区比较，包含未跟踪的文件

diff.scopeNote.staged.zh: 暂存区与 HEAD 比较

diff.binary.en: Binary file; its changes cannot be shown
diff.binary.zh: 二进制文件，无法显示变更

diff.largeCollapsed.zh: 文件较大，{count} 行变更已收起

diff.fileTooLarge.en: This file is too large to show
diff.fileTooLarge.zh: 文件太大，无法显示变更

diff.error.en: The changes could not be read

diff.tooLarge.en: These changes are too large to show here
diff.tooLarge.zh: 变更太大，无法在这里显示

diff.filterConfigFailed.en: No comparison was run because Git filter settings could not be read completely. Check the Git settings and output limit, then retry.
diff.filterConfigFailed.zh: 无法完整读取 Git 过滤器配置，尚未执行比较。请检查 Git 配置和读取上限后重试

diff.noForkPoint.en: No fork point was found for this branch; choose another scope
diff.noForkPoint.zh: 找不到本分支的分叉点，请选择其他范围

diff.omitted.en: {count} more untracked files are not listed
diff.omitted.zh: 另有 {count} 个未跟踪的文件没有列出

diff.stale.en: The local branch has {count} unpushed commits; these are the changes on the change request
diff.stale.zh: 本地有 {count} 个提交尚未推送，这里显示的是变更请求上的变更

diff.openFileInSidebar.en: Open the whole file in the sidebar
diff.openFileInSidebar.zh: 在侧边栏打开整个文件

worktree.hint.en: Run this Session in its own worktree: sending creates a new branch from the chosen one, so changes and commits leave the project directory alone
worktree.hint.zh: 在独立的工作树中运行本会话：发送后基于所选分支新建分支，修改和提交不影响项目目录

worktree.blocked.outside-writable-root.en: The Git data of this workspace is outside the writable directories, as when the workspace is itself a worktree, so it cannot use a worktree yet
worktree.blocked.outside-writable-root.zh: 这个工作区的 Git 数据不在可写目录中（例如工作区本身就是工作树），暂不支持使用工作树

worktree.blocked.read-only.en: A read-only Session cannot use a worktree
worktree.blocked.read-only.zh: 只读模式下无法使用工作树

creation.failed.en: The worktree could not be created

creation.waiting.en: The message is sent once the worktree exists
creation.waiting.zh: 消息会在工作树建好后发送

missing.unknown.en: Worktree restoration is incomplete and branch {branch} cannot be inspected. Resolve the restoration error and retry, or continue in the project.
missing.unknown.zh: 工作树恢复尚未完成，暂时无法确认分支 {branch} 的状态。请排除恢复错误后重试，或在项目目录继续

missing.kept.en: The worktree of branch {branch} can be restored at its original location. Uncommitted changes from before the removal cannot be recovered
missing.kept.zh: 可以在原位置恢复分支 {branch} 的工作树。删除前未提交的修改无法恢复

missing.recreated.en: Branch {branch} was removed too. Restoring creates it again at the commit the worktree started from, without later commits or uncommitted changes
missing.recreated.zh: 分支 {branch} 也已删除。恢复时会从创建时的提交重建分支，之后的提交和未提交的修改无法恢复

missing.waiting.en: The message is sent after you restore the worktree or continue in the project
missing.waiting.zh: 恢复工作树或在项目目录继续后，消息会接着发送

toast.worktreeFailed.en: The worktree option could not change

toast.worktreeStarted.en: This Session has started, so it can no longer use a worktree
toast.worktreeStarted.zh: 会话已开始，无法再改用工作树

toast.restoreFailed.en: The worktree could not be restored: {message}

toast.leaveFailed.en: Could not switch to the project directory; try again
toast.leaveFailed.zh: 无法切换到项目目录，请稍后重试

toast.markedReady.zh: 已将 {name} 标记为可评审

toast.mergeStale.en: {name} has new commits; review them before merging
toast.mergeStale.zh: {name} 有新的提交，确认后再合并

toast.expandFailed.en: Unchanged lines could not be shown: {message}

toast.expandStale.en: The file changed after its changes were read; refresh before expanding
toast.expandStale.zh: 文件在读取变更后又有修改，刷新后再展开

toast.promptFailed.en: The message could not be sent

creationInfo.en: How creation works and token usage
creationInfo.zh: 创建方式与 token 消耗

creationMethod.en: Creator mode builds a new page you can remove at any time.
creationMethod.zh: 用创造模式制作新页面，可随时移除

creationCost.en: Creation may take a while and use a large number of tokens.
creationCost.zh: 创建可能耗时较长，并消耗大量 token

creationBackground.en: Click Create to start in the background. You can keep chatting here.
creationBackground.zh: 点击「创建」后在后台运行，你可以继续聊天

customPlaceholder.en: For example, a left sidebar entry that opens a full-page calendar
customPlaceholder.zh: 例如：在左侧加一个入口，打开全屏日历

scope.en: You can remove it at any time

sourceRetained.en: Undo keeps the source files in the original workspace’s .dsh-created-plugins/ folder.
sourceRetained.zh: 撤销后，源码仍保留在原工作区的 .dsh-created-plugins/ 文件夹中

invalid-location.en: Choose a location or describe it in up to 1,000 characters.
invalid-location.zh: 请选择位置，或填写不超过 1,000 字的位置说明

restart-required.en: The change is saved. Restart DSH to apply it.
restart-required.zh: 变更已保存，重启 DSH 后生效

overridden.zh: 其他配置覆盖了本次变更

applicationFailed.en: The last change did not apply. Check Plugins.
applicationFailed.zh: 上一步更改未生效，请到插件页查看

transport.en: Could not confirm the result. Reconnect and check the card before retrying.
transport.zh: 暂时无法确认结果，请重新连接并查看卡片状态后再重试

unknown.en: This recommendation is no longer available.

unavailable.en: This action is unavailable. Check the plugin in Plugins.
unavailable.zh: 暂时无法执行，请到插件页面查看

access-denied.zh: 当前连接没有修改插件的权限

not-live-root.en: Open the original conversation to use this card.
not-live-root.zh: 请打开原会话后使用这张卡片

closing.en: The creation plugin is stopping. Try again after it reloads.
closing.zh: 创建插件正在停止，请等待重新加载后再试

read-only.en: This Session is read-only. Switch the permission preset to create pages.
read-only.zh: 当前会话为只读模式，创建页面需要切换权限预设

source-missing.en: The page files are gone. Ask for a new proposal.
source-missing.zh: 页面文件已不在，需要重新提案

press.stale.en: That button belonged to an earlier drawing; the band has refreshed
press.stale.zh: 该按钮属于更早的绘制，面板已刷新

unavailable.en: This action is unavailable. Check the plugin in Plugins.
unavailable.zh: 暂时无法执行，请到插件页面查看

transport.en: Could not confirm the result. Reconnect and check the card before retrying.
transport.zh: 暂时无法确认结果，请重新连接并查看卡片状态后再重试

record.rawResultUnavailable.en: Raw results are only available for live tool calls
record.rawResultUnavailable.zh: 原始结果仅在实时工具调用中可用

entry.noViewer.en: No viewer can open this file.
entry.noViewer.zh: 没有可以打开此文件的查看器。

reorderModelHelp.en: Drag to reorder, or use the up and down arrow keys.
reorderModelHelp.zh: 拖动排序，或使用上下方向键调整顺序。

fetchKeepOne.en: Keep at least one model checked.
fetchKeepOne.zh: 请至少保留一个勾选的模型。

desktop.update.fullscreenTimeout.en: Could not exit fullscreen. Exit fullscreen, then retry the update.
desktop.update.fullscreenTimeout.zh: 无法退出全屏，请退出全屏后重试更新

frequency.hostMonthly.en: Monthly on day {days} at {time}, or month end
frequency.hostMonthly.zh: 每月 {days} 日 {time}，不足该日则月末

frequency.hostMonthlyInterval.en: Every {interval} months on day {days} at {time}, or month end
frequency.hostMonthlyInterval.zh: 每 {interval} 个月的 {days} 日 {time}，不足该日则月末

host.createPrompt.en: Please create an automation task based on the requirements.
host.createPrompt.zh: 请根据需求创建一个自动化任务。

host.createError.en: Could not create the task. Your input is preserved; try again.
host.createError.zh: 无法创建任务，已保留填写内容，请重试

host.notFuture.en: Choose a future schedule; edit the task timing before resuming
host.notFuture.zh: 请选择未来的运行时间；恢复前请先修改任务时间

host.invalidRule.en: Check the rule and time zone
host.invalidRule.zh: 请检查规则内容和时区

host.targetNewOnce.en: Create a session and reuse it

host.targetNewOnceHelp.en: Create it on the first run and keep using it
host.targetNewOnceHelp.zh: 首次运行时创建，之后沿用这个会话

host.targetNewHelp.en: Create a separate session for each run
host.targetNewHelp.zh: 每次运行都创建独立会话

host.limitsLoading.zh: 正在读取运行间隔限制

host.limitsError.en: Could not load the run interval limit. Try again before saving.
host.limitsError.zh: 无法读取运行间隔限制，请在保存前重试

host.runAfterInterval.en: The minimum run interval has not passed. Run now is available at {time}.
host.runAfterInterval.zh: 未满最小运行间隔，{time} 后可立即执行

host.saveError.en: Could not save. Your changes are preserved; try again.
host.saveError.zh: 无法保存，已保留修改，请重试

host.conflict.en: This task changed elsewhere. Review the latest values with your edits, or discard your changes.

guideStandardExplanation.en:
### How it works

The agent calls tools directly to read and edit files, search, and run terminal commands. It includes Skills, planning, goals, subagents, workflows, plugin management, and context compaction.

### When to choose it

Start here for everyday coding, file work, and research. Standard mode can also write scripts and process files in batches. PTC changes how tool calls are organized; it is not required for batch tasks.
guideStandardExplanation.zh:
### 工作方式

Agent 直接调用工具来读写文件、检索资料和执行终端命令。包含 Skills、计划、目标、子 Agent、工作流、插件管理和上下文压缩等能力。

### 什么时候选

日常编程、文件处理和资料整理可以从这里开始。标准模式也能编写脚本、批量处理文件；PTC 改变的是工具调用方式，批量任务并不必须使用 PTC。

guidePtcExplanation.en:
### How tools are called

PTC means Programmatic Tool Calling. In this built-in preset, the agent uses run_code to write a TypeScript program that calls tools through a generated SDK. The program can use loops, conditions, error handling, and concurrent calls where appropriate.

### What reaches the model

Tool results first reach the program, which can filter and combine them. The model receives what the program prints or returns; image results are attached separately. Nested tool calls are still recorded and remain subject to tool permissions.

### Compared with Standard mode

Both modes can handle coding and batch tasks. Standard mode exposes individual tools directly; PTC organizes tool calls in code. The current PTC preset leaves the workflow and plugin management tools disabled. Speed and token use depend on the task and how the program handles its results.
guidePtcExplanation.zh:
### 怎样调用工具

PTC 是 Programmatic Tool Calling，即通过程序调用工具。当前内置预设让 Agent 通过 run_code 编写 TypeScript 程序，使用生成的工具 SDK 发起调用。程序可以组织循环、条件判断、错误处理，以及适合并发执行的调用。

### 哪些结果交给模型

工具返回的数据先交给程序，经过筛选、计算或合并，再通过输出或返回值交给模型；图片结果会另行附加。程序中的工具调用仍会被记录，也仍受工具权限约束。

### 与标准模式的区别

两种模式都能编程、批量处理文件。标准模式直接向模型提供各个工具；PTC 让模型用代码组织工具调用。当前 PTC 预设未启用 workflow 和插件管理工具。速度和 token 用量取决于具体任务与结果处理方式。

guideCordisExplanation.en:
### What you can create

Creator mode includes the standard task tools plus runtime inspection and guidance for authoring Cordis plugins and agent presets. It can create a plugin that adds a capability or UI, or a preset that combines tools and prompts for a particular job.

### Plugins and modes

A plugin adds capabilities to DSH, such as a tool, a service connection, or a UI entry. A mode is an agent preset that selects tools and defines how the agent works in a task. A plugin can be included in a custom preset.

### How the result takes effect

Ask the agent to install and verify the result, not just generate source code. A plugin may load immediately or require a restart, depending on what it changes. A newly created preset is selected when starting a new task.
guideCordisExplanation.zh:
### 可以创造什么

创造模式具备标准任务工具，并增加运行时检查，以及 Cordis 插件和 Agent 预设的开发指引。可以编写插件来添加功能或界面，也可以组合工具和提示词，创建适合特定任务的模式。

### 插件与模式的关系

插件为 DSH 增加能力，例如工具、服务连接或界面入口。模式是一份 Agent 预设，用来选择任务可用的工具，并约定 Agent 的工作方式。自定义模式中也可以使用自己开发的插件。

### 怎样让成果生效

可以要求 Agent 完成安装并验证实际效果。插件可能即时加载，也可能需要重启，取决于修改内容；新建的模式在创建新任务时选择。
